name: Image-Based Gaussian Splatting (IBGS)
definition: A method that predicts a color residual ∆c(p) using a lightweight network F(·) to supplement the base color c(p) produced by Gaussian rasterization, leveraging multi-view features to capture high-frequency details and view-dependent lighting.
summary: Image-Based Gaussian Splatting augments 3D Gaussian Splatting by using a neural network to predict color residuals from neighboring views, capturing high-frequency details without increasing storage.
